question: Why were the 0012 CPU and first 0014 QNN samples unusable, and can a source-valid Pocket contract be recovered before further acceleration?

contract.text: Pocket TTS runs entirely on this Android phone using the original floating point model.
contract.voice: official pinned precomputed Alba state; fixed-voice synthesis, not audio voice cloning

gates_in_order: Generate exact official-source Bria and Alba controls and obtain Moritz's sample-bound verdict.
Localize source-versus-ONNX divergence step-by-step; numerical evidence cannot substitute for listening.
Generate controlled FP ONNX plus fixed Alba on host CPU and obtain an independent listening verdict.
Run Android CPU before HTP and obtain a separate listening verdict; host acceptance does not transfer across runtime/platform.
For a QNN-compatible derivative, obtain host CPU acceptance and then Android CPU acceptance before physical HTP.
Physical HTP requires fallback disabled, zero CPU provider events, all invoked neural calls assigned to QNN, and matching RPC/accelerator/cycle/HVX evidence.
Every new phone sample requires an independent Moritz listening verdict before any quality or deployment claim.
root_cause_fail_closed_rule: The no-voice-cloning checkpoint must reject audio-reference cloning. Bria is retained only as historical invalid-contract evidence and for the distinct 0008 archive audit; it is not a valid voice input for the controlled checkpoint.

qnn_static_boundary.reason: 126 + 26 + 100 = 252, so every observed position remains in the fixed cache. Larger caps would roll away voice context and require a separate contract.
qnn_static_boundary.cpu_work: fixed token IDs, prepacked official state, deterministic noise fixture, state ownership, EOS scan, call orchestration, concatenation, and WAV encoding
qnn_static_boundary.neural_work: text conditioner, text prefill, every BOS/latent AR call, every flow call, and every Mimi decoder call

phone_controls.lock: actual nonblocking flock on artifacts/locks/phone.lock; lock FD closed in ADB children
phone_controls.cleanup: pull evidence, delete the exact remote stage, verify it is absent, then release the lock
